name: starpoint
description: A server reimplementation for the global version of World Flipper

scripts.debug: npm run css && npm run css:watch & npm run debug:ts-only
scripts.test:cn-assets: node scripts/protocol-lab/test-cn-orderedmap.mjs && node scripts/protocol-lab/test-cn-gacha-region-policy.mjs && npm run audit:cn-character-mana && npm run test:cn-shop-reward-audit
scripts.test:cn: npm run build && node scripts/protocol-lab/test-cn-server.js && node scripts/protocol-lab/test-cn-leiting-response.mjs && node scripts/protocol-lab/test-cn-http-metadata-observer.mjs
scripts.check:cn-personal-service-fixtures: npx tsc && node scripts/protocol-lab/generate-cn-default-player-fixture.mjs --output core/personal-service/assets/cn-default-player.json && node scripts/protocol-lab/generate-cn-single-battle-fixture.mjs --asset-root ../startpoint-cn-launcher/resources/server/assets --output core/personal-service/assets/cn-single-battle.json && node scripts/protocol-lab/test-cn-single-battle-fixture.mjs && node scripts/protocol-lab/generate-cn-mission-fixture.mjs --asset-root ../startpoint-cn-launcher/resources/server/assets --output core/personal-service/assets/cn-mission-master.json --check && git diff --exit-code -- core/personal-service/assets/cn-default-player.json core/personal-service/assets/cn-single-battle.json core/personal-service/assets/cn-mission-master.json
scripts.test:management-personal-service-sync: npm run build && cargo +1.78.0 build --locked --manifest-path core/personal-service/Cargo.toml --bin personal-service-probe && node scripts/protocol-lab/test-management.js --personal-service-save-sync
scripts.test:android-personal-service: uv run --python 3.12 python -m unittest discover -s platforms/android/tests -p test_*.py
scripts.test:personal-service: cargo test --jobs 1 --manifest-path core/personal-service/Cargo.toml -- --test-threads=1 && uv run --python 3.12 python scripts/protocol-lab/test_ios_inventory.py && uv run --python 3.12 python scripts/protocol-lab/test_ios_cn_aot_patch.py && uv run --python 3.12 python scripts/protocol-lab/test_ios_cn_compatibility_patch.py && uv run --python 3.12 python scripts/protocol-lab/test_package_ios_personal_service.py && npm run test:ios-personal-service-bootstrap && npm run test:ios-validation-runner && npm run test:ios-cn-candidate-runner
scripts.verify:local: npm run test:protocol-coverage && npm run test:cn-evidence && npm run test:cn-m4-summary && npm run test:isolated-cn-service && npm run test:portable-save && npm run test:portable-save-roundtrip && npm run test:cn-assets && npm run test:cn-activity-banners && npm run test:cn-gacha && npm run test:cn && npm run test:management && npm run test:multiplayer-time && npm run test:management-personal-service-sync && npm run test:personal-service && npm run test:android-personal-service
